title: Philips Hue Grow Light Cycle Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hue:event
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by zone_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Philips Hue grow light cycle data has stopped arriving for a given zone name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per zone name and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your Philips Hue grow light cycle feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
